space.description: 'model' (design space, US survey feet) or a sheet id/name (paper space, inches), e.g. 'SH-004' or 'P-201'

path_ids.description: line/polyline/arc entity ids forming the centerline, in order along it (entity-chain mode); with chain=true, any one or more of them

chain.description: entity-chain mode: follow the elements joined end to end from path_ids, so one id stations the whole centerline; stops where the linework branches, unless path_ids names the way on

alignment.description: design-model alignment name: true stations, equations, and anchored output (alternative to path_ids); a referenced one as 'BASE:ALIGN-1'

lettering.description: alignment mode: 'caltrans' (default) letters the whole station number at each 500 ft and the ones digit elsewhere (85, 6, 7, ... 90); 'full' letters every station 86+00.00

station_side.description: alignment mode: where the station numbers go; default below the line

point_side.description: alignment mode: where the BC/EC and equation lettering goes, square to the line and reading bottom to top; default left

view_rotation.description: alignment mode: the twist (rotation_deg) of the viewport the labels are read through; they are lettered upright on that sheet instead of in the model (default 0, an untwisted view)

point_label_offset.description: alignment mode: BC/EC and equation distance from the line (default 22.5 ft, or the annotation scale x 0.45 in)

begin_station.description: entity-chain mode: the station (feet, or '15+90.29') at the start of the first element, or at start_point when given

start_point.description: entity-chain mode: a point on the path where begin_station is known; stations run on from the end of the path nearer it

reverse.description: entity-chain mode: run the stations the other way along the path

station_range.description: alignment mode: only annotate between these display stations

include_equations.description: alignment mode: label station equations (default true)

tick_half_len.description: tick half-length each side of the path (default 3.5 ft, a 7 ft tick at 1" = 50', or the annotation scale x 0.07 in)

text_height.description: label height (default 8 ft, or the annotation scale x 0.10 in)

label_offset.description: station number distance from the path, below it (default 6 ft, or the annotation scale x 0.12 in: half a text height under the tick); negative is the older way of asking for stations on the right, BC/EC left

label_layer.description: layer for labels; default same as ticks

include_pc_pt.description: letter BC/EC/PCC/PRC at the curve points (default true)

connect_tolerance.description: max gap between path elements (default 1 ft)
